newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results May 12-16.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results May 12-16.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for the week of May 12-16:
NOTES - Profit figures exclude extraordinary items and are in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated. They are stated before deduction of preference dividends where applicable.
Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas is due to report first quarter results on Tuesday May 13 before bourse opening.
Since it is the first time this company reports quarterly earnings figures and there are no comparative data available, most analysts declined to give an earnings forecast.
REUTER INSTRUMENT CODES (RICs) for the companies mentioned:
Stad Rotterdam, Aegon, CSM, Hunter Douglas.
FORECASTS CONTRIBUTED BY: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, ING Barings, Labouchere, Van Lanschot, NIB Secuties, Rabo Securities, SNS Securities, Wesselius.
